messages.author: 972e2ef0c27b2b6b
messages.subject: glimmer directory index
parts:
Hi,

I have a set of applications hosted on glimmer and I would like them to be accessible in the parent directory, i.e. glimmer.rstudio.com/andeek, via a list of links. I think this corresponds to directory_index on server config (but I'm not sure). Is this something that is possible on glimmer or shinyapps?

Thank you in advance!

Andee

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: glimmer directory index
parts:
I asked the same question back in 2012 when glimmer was still
experimental. I do not think it will happen on the glimmer/spark
servers (they will be retired by the end of this year). For
ShinyApps.io, I'm not sure if it will be implemented (cc'ed to the
shinyapps mailing list).

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: glimmer directory index
parts:
Sorry I'm not quite sure, because I do not work on the shiny hosting
service. However, it should be fairly easy for you to do it by
yourself using a little HTML trick, e.g. in your ui.R, you can
redirect the page using the <meta> info:

shinyUI(basicPage(
tags$head(
tags$meta(`http-equiv` = 'refresh', content =
'0;URL=https://gallery.shinyapps.io/001-hello')
)
))

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: glimmer directory index
parts:
Hi Gregory,
When the time comes to shut down spark and glimmer, we will definitely provide a migration path that makes it easy for folks to move over.  No worries.   It isn't something high on our list right now, and shinyapps.io is definitely at a place right now that if you wanted to move your apps over yourself and point people to it, you would be able to do so today.  Let us know if you need any help learning how to do that, or you could wait until we got to the migration of spark/glimmer to shinyapps.io.

Best,
Tareef
